title: Prerelease files: where they live and when they move
summary: I agree the prerelease work should leave agents/ceo/. I recommend analysis/prerelease/<set>/ at the root (fra/ with its back-test, trk/), reusable code staying in scripts/prerelease/, and the move after the event, on Monday 9 November. A move this week would land on Wednesday, after DEC-1221, and would not improve Friday's sheet. Sections 3 and 4 of my comment give the details. The Scryfall links and the PDF are already started (DEC-1221).
